description: Labelled per-message skill routing cases (docs/SKILL_ROUTING.md). Synthetic, fictional chats. expected lists every acceptable routable skill id for the role's default set (pinned skills excluded), or ["none"] when no playbook should be loaded. Optional tags: smalltalk, quickfact, ambiguous, history, pinned-adjacent.
